caption:
You're not wrong to worry.

A bot with no boundaries will eventually promise a same-day slot that doesn't exist, or quote a price nobody approved. That's a real failure mode, and it's exactly why the first message needs a strict job description.

The fix: the first automated message only confirms and buys time. It never negotiates. A real person picks it up from one shared inbox, with the whole conversation already there.

That's the version worth running.

rationale: 2026 benchmarks show carousels still lead saves/depth for B2B objection-handling, and this resolves an unclaimed fear (automation overpromising/erring before a human can catch it) distinct from every impersonal, cost, onboarding, brand-voice, and complexity objection already shipped.
